name: Pipe Diameter Calculator
description: Calculate required pipe diameter from flow rate and target velocity.

seo.title: Pipe Diameter Calculator - Size Pipes
seo.description: Calculate the minimum pipe inner diameter needed for a given flow rate and target velocity.

formula.explanation: D = √(4Q / (π × v)). Flow in m³/s, velocity in m/s; ×1000 converts m to mm.

content.introduction: Calculate the minimum pipe inner diameter for a given flow rate and design velocity. Essential for hydraulic pipe sizing in process and utility systems.

example.description: For 50 m³/h at 2 m/s target velocity, minimum diameter is 94 mm. Standard DN100 (114.3mm OD, ~102mm ID) would work.

faq.q: What standard pipe size should I select?
faq.a: Round up to the nearest standard DN/NPS size. For example, if calc gives 94mm, select DN100 (4-inch).

faq.q: What velocity should I design for?
faq.a: Water discharge: 2-3 m/s; suction: <1.5 m/s; compressed air: 6-10 m/s; natural gas: 10-20 m/s.
